title: FunSearch produces a cap set of size 512 in dimension 8 and improves the asymptotic cap set lower bound
summary: FunSearch produced a size-512 cap set in dimension 8 and new asymptotic bounds, published in Nature with independent commentary.
account: On 14 December 2023 Nature published a paper by Google DeepMind researchers with mathematician Jordan Ellenberg (University of Wisconsin–Madison) describing FunSearch. FunSearch pairs a pretrained large language model (LLM) that proposes programs with an automated evaluator that scores them, in an island-based evolutionary loop. Applied to the cap set problem, FunSearch produced a program generating a cap set of size 512 in dimension 8. The previous best known construction was 496. It found admissible sets that raised the asymptotic lower bound from 2.2180 to 2.2202 after Ellenberg exploited a symmetry noticed in the program's output. Independent commentary by Ernest Davis (NYU, 11 January 2024) accepts the constructions as genuine but rates their mathematical importance as moderate. Terence Tao called the approach a promising paradigm.
purpose: Built to search program space for constructions and heuristics in mathematics and computer science. The cap set constructions were that purpose.
system: FunSearch (LLM-guided evolutionary program search with automated evaluator)
deployer: Google DeepMind with Jordan Ellenberg (University of Wisconsin–Madison)
segment: Industrial research laboratory with academic collaborator

ratings.reason: Mathematicians gained an explicit cap set of size 512 in dimension 8 and an improved asymptotic bound. Davis's independent comment judges the results moderately interesting mathematically.

ai_role.statement: FunSearch generated the programs whose outputs are the cap sets and admissible sets. These are explicit finite objects that the evaluator and readers can verify mechanically. The 2.2202 bound depended on a human (Ellenberg) noticing a symmetry in FunSearch's output and refocusing the search. Davis identifies that as the most notable aspect.

headline: DeepMind's FunSearch finds a size-512 cap set in dimension 8
metric: cap set of size 512 in dimension 8, exceeding the previous best known construction of 496

comparator.against: the previous best known cap set construction in dimension 8
comparator.quote: First: FunSearch found a cap set of size 512 for n = 8. The previous best known cap set had size 496. It thus established a lower bound c8 ≥ 512

later.note: The FunSearch constructions stood and were built on: a later LLM-driven method (X-evolve) raised the asymptotic cap set lower bound further from 2.2202 to 2.2203.
later.quote: For the cap set problem, we discover a larger partial admissible set, establishing a new tighter asymptotic lower bound for the cap set constant (C ≥ 2.2203).
